answer: Collateral lockup imposes a quadratic slashing curve where each extra validator stake adds a ridge penalty proportional to the square of its share, pushing marginal Sybil cost to O(n^2). The protocol's jade liquidity sink forces attackers to commit super-linear capital, at least 3.2x honest stake, to gain any fork chance. An ivory security threshold of 67% bonded value ensures expected gain stays below total slashing loss, making rational attacks uneconomic.
